correctness.rationale: Derive exact deck-orbit distance formula for all a,b>0; use surjective integer determinant-two endomorphism of the horizontal torus to obtain independent uniform circular distances. The symmetric triangular vertical-offset integral equals a uniform-offset integral, proving the entire CDF. The min identity and elementary moments E(Z²)=8/45, E|Z|=1/3 yield an exact energy representation. Pointwise inequalities K(w)≥(1−3w²)/2 and K(w)≥−w give strict global monotonicity on either side of t*=sqrt(5−sqrt15), with no omitted t>2 domain. All algebra and endpoint cases are explicit. The embedded deterministic Python checker passed direct deck-orbit tests on 12,600 pairs, 7×125,000 pair energy simulations, 12 CDF quadratures and numerical energy comparisons. Computation supports but does not prove the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: Normalized mean-square geodesic separation is a natural intrinsic random-shape statistic for nonorientable compact flat surfaces. The entire law and one-parameter sharp fixed-area optimization produce an unexpected unique slightly nonsquare optimum. The exact group-action factorization and global derivative inequalities supply structural results across a continuous moduli family, rather than a single numerical example or routine substitution. Potential applications include stochastic geometric reconstruction and benchmarking sampling methods; no downstream theorem is claimed.
